harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (RHEL 7.9, BIOS grub2) to boot with audit=1 persistently by adding it to GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX in /etc/default/grub and applying it to all grub2 kernel entries via `grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=audit=1`. Rebooted node1 to confirm persistence, verified boot_id changed (real restart), and confirmed /proc/cmdline and the kernel audit subsystem (auditctl -s, dmesg) reflect audit=1 post-reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected current /proc/cmdline, /etc/default/grub, and grub2 layout (BIOS, i386-pc) on node1
Confirmed grubby package present at /usr/sbin/grubby and listed existing kernel entries (default + rescue)
Appended audit=1 to GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX in /etc/default/grub via sed
Applied audit=1 to all kernel entries in grub.cfg using `grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=audit=1`
Verified grub.cfg linux16 lines for both the default and rescue kernels now include audit=1
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime -s, /proc/cmdline (no audit=1 yet, pending reboot), auditd/auditctl state (enabled 0)
Issued `sudo systemctl reboot` on node1; connection dropped confirming acknowledgement before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Verified new boot_id differs from baseline, proving an actual restart occurred
Verified /proc/cmdline now includes audit=1, auditctl -s reports kernel audit enabled=1 (was 0), and dmesg shows the audit subsystem initializing at boot

evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state captured before restart (boot identity, cmdline, audit state)
evidence.summary: Captured initial /proc/cmdline (no audit=1), boot_id 33b0e84c-4dd1-406a-8f89-2e8ceca97bd6, uptime -s, and auditctl -s showing kernel audit enabled=0 prior to change taking effect

evidence.requirement: audit=1 added to GRUB config and applied to all kernel entries for persistence
evidence.summary: GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX in /etc/default/grub updated with audit=1; grubby applied audit=1 to both the default and rescue kernel entries; grub.cfg on-disk linux16 lines confirmed to include audit=1 for both entries

evidence.requirement: Single node restarted one at a time with acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: `sudo systemctl reboot` issued on node1; command returned reboot-issued acknowledgement and then the SSH connection closed, confirming the restart was triggered

evidence.requirement: Node polled until reachable again, with proof of changed boot identity (not just elapsed time)
evidence.summary: First poll timed out (node still rebooting); second poll succeeded and returned a new boot_id (dddcd817-01b0-4754-83d8-61a7339135f6) differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual kernel restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart proof that audit=1 is active and persisted across reboot
evidence.summary: After reboot, /proc/cmdline includes audit=1, auditctl -s reports kernel audit enabled=1 (changed from 0 pre-restart), and dmesg shows the audit subsystem initializing at boot, confirming the kernel booted with audit=1 and the setting survives reboot
